data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3487 merged as 9d10232dd89 on origin/main (current revision ce1dd4a3570: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). AC1: the enumeration is recorded in this ticket's 2026-11-19 comment (not exposed, lock-protected, and exposed-but-harmless cache misses) plus the description's list of exposed readers with a harmful outcome. AC2: each of those readers now reads through fsutil.open_published / published_is_file / retry_contended, and the shown-not-to-need cases are the recorded cache misses. tests/unit/store/test_fsutil_read_retry.py forces the Windows branch (_RETRY_CONTENDED_REPLACE=True) and covers retry, deadline, missing file and the POSIX branch; its AST wiring test pins every listed reader to a retried helper with no unretried existence check. On origin/main 9d10232dd89 it and test_bridge_state_atomic_write_concurrency.py report 53 passed.
